# Speech fixture

`speech-tone.mp3` is Chromium's small `media/test/data/sfx.mp3` test sound:
https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/main/media/test/data/sfx.mp3

Chromium source is distributed under its BSD license, copied in `CHROMIUM_LICENSE`:
https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/main/LICENSE

The browser tests mute the audio and use synthetic data only, without provider requests.
